2.en: All manner of rumours make their way to agents of the Inquisition, and most are ignored. Not so for a missive from Virida, as it arrived with the characters' Patron bearing the cypher key of an Inquisitor thought dead a century past. The message itself was short, the fact of its existence far more unusual than its content, and warranting an investigation on that account alone. This was, as it happens, precisely the sender’s intent.

12.en: ++ Priority alert. Planet Virida, Drimor Subsector. Suspected xenos infiltration. Possible compromise of high-ranking individuals within Imperial authorities. Assistance required. End message. ++

18.en: This Case File works best as an isolated part or detour of a more extensive campaign. It can introduce the characters to the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari} xenos threat (such as @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-actors.Actor.KZk1yGduhULvMbmP]{Varon Vipersong}). Though it takes place on @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.WFgd7THvx3MHyhNd]{Virida}, any world that might invite the presence of Drukhari raiders may suit.

32.en: Inquisitor Bartolos vanished in the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.d0lv2v4FkeIb43jj]{Drimor Subsector} in 850.M41. An @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} Inquisitor of modest achievement, Bartolos was on the trail of a @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari} sympathiser when he disappeared. Several attempts to locate the Inquisitor failed, and his name was added to the long list of worthy dead carved into the monolith of service on @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.FNEW8e33IisZh27W.JournalEntryPage.Y1wjtyi7JdgHxQiF#mare-cinis]{Mare Cinis} and recalled after that only in the records held there.

36.en: While it is not impossible that Bartolos still lives, it seems unlikely that, if this were the case, he would have waited so long to contact his fellow Inquisitors or be without any explanation for his absence.

40.en: Further, the message, though bearing his seal, does not conform to his previous writings, which tended to be verbose and elaborate rather than short and direct.

44.en: In fact, the message has been sent by Proctor Llewellyn Verane, Inquisitor Bartolos’s daughter. Wearied by his long service to the Imperium, Inquisitor Bartolos cast off his pledge to the Emperor. He retired — an almost unheard-of luxury for an Inquisitor and a betrayal of every oath he had sworn in the Emperor’s name. Worst of all, he has escaped punishment by the simplest means of all — he died in his bed several decades ago.

48.en: He told his daughter something of his life as an Inquisitor — more than he should have, and enough for her to know the peril of reaching out using her father’s name as an alias. However, Verane has cause for alarm and — rightly, as it happens — believes it warrants the Inquisition’s attention. As an @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.3TtxuCzt0nNV1ysj]{Administratum} clerk on the jungle-covered world of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.B7MZBBT3bNew9N96.JournalEntryPage.WFgd7THvx3MHyhNd]{Virida}, she has been tracking deaths among the citizens. She noticed an unusual pattern of deaths confined to a particular zone of the jungle and brought it to her superiors. The region was investigated, but nothing unusual was found; her concerns were quickly written off as a statistical anomaly or paranoia. Now Laal’s Citadel, one of the great servo-cities that strides across the surface of Virida, is approaching the zone, and the proctor fears the worst — that whatever threat stalks the forests will claim the population of an entire city. Desperate, she did as she promised her father she would never do and used her Adminstratrum connections and his Inquisitorial seal to plead for aid.

52.en: In truth, the jungle itself is not to blame, but a @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari} presence hidden within it. The xenos raiders found the planet inimical to them and decided to lure their prey to them instead. Bribing the governor of Laal’s Citadel to alter its route towards a hidden entrance to the Webway, they intend to launch a surprise raid. Should they be successful, the entire servo-city and its millions of citizens might find themselves dragged off to captivity in the dark city of Commorragh.

66.en: Of course, the characters may find themselves more interested in locating Inquisitor Bartolos than listening to his daughter’s wild tales of disappearances in a jungle with a history of hostility towards intruders. If pressed, she can show them to his final resting place, an unmarked grave at the mouth of a cave atop the Juncta Plateau, a truly inhospitable region of the planet-spanning jungle. He was not consigned to the corpse recyclers lest Inquisitorial marker-pathogens in his blood alert the wider Inquisition to his death. The interred skeleton is indeed the Inquisitor’s, the lone augmetic eye still staring from one eye socket, the digital weapon gifted for his routing of the heretek Loftus Kar from Hexas Panan gleaming upon one skeletal finger.

70.en: The coordinates attached to the message sent using Bartolos’s cyphers lead to Laal’s Citadel, a mighty serv-ocity. When the characters reach it, Verane will contact them, guiding them with messages hidden amidst a ceaseless barrage of @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-core-journals.JournalEntry.GPqYZykonC12TJb1.JournalEntryPage.3TtxuCzt0nNV1ysj]{Administratum} paperwork, much of it delivered by randomly appointed couriers, minor scribes, servo-skulls, and other obscure means. She attempts to direct the characters towards her discoveries — the excessive deaths and a sudden change in the city’s trajectory towards the anomalous region of the jungle.

74.en: If the characters pursue her leads, they will find the sharp scribe quickly sets them on the right path to the office of Cityspeaker Naurane Wicht, one of the servo-city’s highest-ranking officials. Offered a simple deal by the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.xxcZ1PUz0t1ycevK.JournalEntryPage.GyAY9bnCmCZ3JjzK#drukhari]{Drukhari} — bring us your city in exchange for your own life — Wicht chose her own pitiable life over that of the millions whose safety was entrusted to her. When confronted by Inquisitorial authority, she quickly breaks down and will offer no resistance.

82.en: However, it is up to the characters how they wish to proceed. They may use Wicht to lure a party of Drukhari raiders to their doom, preparing the servo-city's void shields and interception batteries, which Wicht had promised to disable for their attack under the pretence of essential maintenance. Alternatively, they may wish to avoid the area near the Webway portal or seek to destroy it.

86.en: They may also wish to pursue Bartolos and, in the process, discover Verane. She has no love for the Inquisition but would make an exemplary operative if convinced to join them by a persuasive character. Either way, the characters' Patron will point out that she knows far too much to be allowed to remain beyond the Inquisition’s reach and must be recruited or killed. Recovering Bartolos’ corpse for post-mortem punishment is also a priority — any Inquisitor who betrays their oaths must be made to answer for it, in spirit if not in fact.

90.en: If the characters are successful, Laal’s Citadel remains standing. If Verane is recruited, in addition to standard XP and solar rewards, their Influence with the @UUID[Compendium.apex-imperialis.navis-inquisition-journals.JournalEntry.brh2O5CexxurRbM7.JournalEntryPage.YFKg8L1rfWbScqkr#ordo-xenos]{Ordo Xenos} increases by 1.
